crossRefs.note: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice. Arise, flee to Laban, my brother, in Haran.
“Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.
“ ‘Each one of you shall respect his mother and his father. You shall keep my Sabbaths. I am Yahweh your God.
My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching:
“The eye that mocks at his father, and scorns obedience to his mother: the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, the…
Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
“that it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.”
Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.
